name: Gnikool Ssalg
description: You are given a string. Reverse its characters.
input_specification: The only line of input contains a string between 1 and 100 characters long. Each character of the string has ASCII-code between 33 (exclamation mark) and 126 (tilde), inclusive.
output_specification: Output the characters of this string in reverse order.
subsubtopic: 406. Knuth Morris Pratt (KMP) and Prefix Automaton
approach_summary: Precompute the prefix function π[i] matching longest proper prefix-suffix in O(M). Traverse text string with π transitions to locate all occurrences in O(N) time.
